props.name: variant
props.description: Grid lines, or a dot at every intersection.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of one cell in pixels.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between changes. Each change swaps a few cells, not all of them.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the grid out towards the edges, so it sits behind a heading rather than boxing it in.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Place the layer inside a positioned container.
